name: OneRobotics (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd.
summary: OneRobotics (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. designs, develops, manufactures, and sells home robotics system products and other home robot products and accessories in Japan, Europe, North America, and rest of the world. The company develops SwitchBot App that enables users to achieve centralized control of home robotic system products for intelligent home living experience.
